rigidAxioms: Dual-track parity: Rust native engine & TS facade must match 100% byte-for-byte; zero panic (RSM-PNC-001).
Zero network & physical sandbox: Analyzer logic strictly forbids undeclared network requests (DEF-NET-001).
Zero transient heap allocation in loops: Eliminate GC jitter on hot paths (ADV-PRF-002 / CPX-SPACE-001).
Deterministic AST traversal: Enforce deterministic ordering across runs (DET-AST-001).
Anti-gaming circuit breaker: Zero shell facades or pass-through trampolines (RCFG-RULE-DRIFT / ARCH-ABS-001).
Strongly-typed error semantics: Propagate typed errors; zero swallowed exceptions (RSM-PNC-001).
Benchmark protection: Mandatory positive/negative tests; zero regression in benchmark timings.
